bugs.title: dispatch_reassign prompt retains previous role in execution instructions after explicit reassignment role

evidence.symptom: A real dispatch_reassign prompt with --role=lattice-implementer rendered top-level Role: lattice-implementer but inherited Execution Instructions still said Work in role: overflow-worker.
reproSteps: Create and run a fake dispatch to accepted_local with previous role overflow-worker.
Open the generated prompt.md and observe conflicting role instructions.
evidence.hypothesis: Reassignment reused previous executionInstructions verbatim, including old role-specific lines.
evidence.rootCause: reassignDispatch inherited the previous pack executionInstructions without normalizing role-specific instructions for the requested reassignment role.
evidence.fixEvidence: Reassignment now rewrites inherited Work in role instructions to the current reassignment role; smoke asserts Role: lattice-implementer and Work in role: lattice-implementer are present while Work in role: overflow-worker is absent.
evidence.reproTest: packages/main/src/tasks/dispatch-run-smoke.ts dispatch_reassign explicit role prompt assertions; node packages/main/dist/tasks/dispatch-run-smoke.js passed; lattice validate --story=B-99d4 --json passed.
